{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check unique values in customer_segment
print(f"Unique customer_segments: {sales['customer_segment'].unique()}")

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {(sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")

# Check revenue format
print(f"First 5 revenue values: {sales['revenue'].head(5).tolist()}")"}
